people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Gad
people.line: Prophet during the reigns of David and Solomon.

people.name: Jebusites
people.line: Canaanite tribe inhabiting Jerusalem before David's conquest

people.name: Ornan
people.line: Jebusite, sold threshing floor to David

translations.web: Then Yahweh’s angel commanded Gad to tell David that David should go up and raise an altar to Yahweh on the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.
translations.bsb: Then the angel of the LORD ordered Gad to tell David to go up and build an altar to the LORD on the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.
translations.kjv: Then the angel of the LORD commanded Gad to say to David, that David should go up, and set up an altar unto the LORD in the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite.
translations.asv: Then the angel of Jehovah commanded Gad to say to David, that David should go up, and rear an altar unto Jehovah in the threshing-floor of Ornan the Jebusite.
